Messages.Body:
I have a question about carrion crows..

what happens when vampireA plays carrion crows and vampireB plays
Majesty? Will vampB still take damage at strike resolution?
I don't think so due to the S:CE..but you never know..

How about if VampB plays Blood of Acid instead?

Will VampA take 2 points of aggravated damage from blood of acid due to
carrion crows damage? or does blood of acid pertain only to strikes?

Sent via Deja.com http://www.deja.com/
Before you buy.

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
On Thu, 10 Feb 2000 mads...@my-deja.com wrote:
> what happens when vampireA plays carrion crows and vampireB plays
> Majesty? Will vampB still take damage at strike resolution?

No, because S:CE stops strike resolution before anything else is done.

> How about if VampB plays Blood of Acid instead?
>
> Will VampA take 2 points of aggravated damage from blood of acid due to
> carrion crows damage? or does blood of acid pertain only to strikes?

Carrion crows deals environmental damage (the opposing minion takes,
rather than "this vampire inflicts x upon the opposing minion). BoA cares
about the damage VampA inflicts - which is 0 from the crows. However, he
would probably end up taking 1 for hand damage he inflicts (assuming he
strikes for hand damage and it resolves - if VampB still Majesty's, no
damage is done anyway).

--

James Coupe
